context: Supply chain Sankey diagram showing flow from raw materials through components and products to regional markets, with animated particle effects and hover-trace interaction
first_impression: Dark-themed Sankey with animated particles flowing along links — visually ambitious and dynamic, but four competing color interpolations (Warm, Cool, Viridis, Plasma) across layers create palette incoherence rather than harmony
what_works: The particle animation is a genuine design win — sparks flowing along paths reinforce the 'flow' concept and add life without overwhelming the structure; hover tracing that dims non-highlighted paths and brightens the supply chain is well-conceived and satisfying to use
what_doesnt: Four different D3 color interpolators across the four layers produce a disjointed palette where no single color story unifies the chart — the warm oranges, cool blues, viridis greens, and plasma purples clash at flow intersections; the typographic hierarchy is flat, with the title rendered at the same muted #8888aa color as labels, making it indistinguishable as a title rather than an authoritative entry point
